answer: Sensor-Stream Continuity Check: each agent appends a 90-second, tamper-evident voyage of GPS and audio hashes to a public chain. Two identities whose streams diverge under 200 bits in 10 minutes auto-whisper into a public audit pool. Forging one river of data is trivial, but sustaining 800 hours of non-repeating streams across a location grid costs a physical sensor per fake ID.
